summary: Campaign additions are bounded, optional, immutable after creation, and validated on create and update. Client writes cannot forge report-delivery fields. Existing Passport possession-based access remains a separate security concern.

findings.issue: Existing unclaimed assessments permit single-document reads and contact edits by a holder of the assessment ID; records may contain contact information. Account claim is likewise possession-based.
findings.recommendation: Before broad promotion, review a server-mediated claim/contact capability with separate public and private projections. Do not interpret a UUID as authenticated ownership. This implementation adds no read, contact, or claim permissions.
